title: A prompt template opens a form described in its config
body:
A prompt template today (`src/template.rs`, `[templates.<name>]` in `config.toml`) is a `text` with `{blank}` placeholders. `/t <name>` puts the text in the prompt with each blank marked, and Tab moves between them. That suits one-word blanks but not a list of tasks or a choice among a few answers.

coax already draws a form for Claude's `AskUserQuestion`: `Form` in `src/form.rs`. Its field kinds are `Choice` (one option, with an optional typed Other), `Many` (any number of options), `Text` (optionally a number) and `Toggle`. A template form reuses that box, filled from the config instead of from the agent.

## Proposal

Firing a template that has any blanks opens its form, always. A template with no blanks sends at once, as now. The in-place blank editing in the prompt goes away.

A blank with no table of its own is a one-line text field labelled with its name. A blank that needs more gets a table under `fields`:

```toml
[templates.away]
description = "a list of tasks before stepping away"
preview = true
text = """
{tasks}

i'm stepping away for {time}, so get through as much of this as you can.
{questions}"""

[templates.away.fields.tasks]
label = "what should get done?"
kind = "list"
item = "- {}"

[templates.away.fields.time]
label = "how long?"
kind = "choice"
options = ["an hour", "a few hours", "the night"]
other = true

[templates.away.fields.questions]
label = "want questions first?"
kind = "toggle"
on = "ask any questions now and we'll review when i return"
off = "don't wait on me for questions"
```

| `kind` | the form shows | goes into the text as |
|---|---|---|
| `line`, the default | a one-line input | what was typed |
| `text` | a multi-line input | what was typed |
| `list` | a multi-line input, one item per line | each line through `item` (default `{}`), joined by newlines |
| `choice` | one option, plus a typed Other when `other = true` | the option, or the Other text |
| `many` | any number of options | the ticked options joined by `join` (default `", "`) |
| `toggle` | yes or no | `on` or `off` |

Every field also takes `label`, `help` (a dim line under the label), `default` and `optional = true`. An optional field left empty puts nothing into the text, and a required one blocks finishing the form.

The form shows every field on one page, in the order the blanks appear in the text. Tab and Shift+Tab move between fields. Enter in a `list` or `text` field adds a line, and Enter elsewhere, or Ctrl+Enter anywhere, finishes the form. Esc cancels it.

These are Jack's decisions:

- Finishing the form puts the filled text in the prompt for a last edit. A template with `send = true` sends at once instead.
- A live preview of the filled text sits under the fields when the template sets `preview = true`. A button in the form toggles it.
- One column only. Layout control waits until a template needs it.
- Every template with blanks opens the form, even when all its fields are plain lines.

## Out of scope

- Filling blanks from words after the name on `/t`, which is coax-d8f50e.

## Open

- How a `list` field draws its lines in the form: as a bordered text area, or as lines marked with the `item` prefix.
- Whether `default` on a `list` takes an array.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text:
The form is built and uncommitted on `dev`. What landed:

- `src/template.rs` parses `[templates.<name>]` through `RawTemplate` and each field through `RawField`, into `Template` and `Field` with a `Kind` per field kind. Each kind carries only its own settings. A key that belongs to another kind, a choice or many without options, a default of the wrong type, or a field table that names no blank in the text is a config error, which `Config::load` reports with the file's path. `Template::fill` writes the answers into the text, or returns the first field that needs an answer. `Template::preview` leaves each unanswered blank as `{name}`.
- `src/form.rs` adds `Form::template`, which builds the same `Form` the `AskUserQuestion` box draws. It has one field per blank and a typed Other field, keyed `<blank>_custom`, after a choice with `other = true`. `Form::answers` reads the fields back, with a typed Other taking the place of the pick. `Kind::Text` gains `lines`, so Enter adds a line in a `text` or `list` field. Tab and Shift+Tab move a question at a time in any form. In a template form, Enter on a one-line field or a toggle finishes, and so does Ctrl+Enter anywhere.
- `src/app.rs` holds the open form as `TemplateForm` with its `preview` flag. Ctrl+P and a click on the form's preview button flip it. Finishing fills the prompt with the cursor at the end, or sends it when the template sets `send = true`. The in-place blanks are gone: `blanks`, `chosen_blank`, `next_blank`, `spots`, and the blank drawing in `draw_input`.
- `src/ui.rs` draws the template form in the space of the agent's form, with the preview under a rule. A template form may grow to all but 10 rows of the screen, where an agent's form stops at half.

The two open points are settled:

- A `list` field draws as a plain text area, one item per line. The `item` prefix shows only in the preview and in the sent text.
- A `list` default may be an array of items or a string of lines.

Jack's five templates in his `config.toml` use the new syntax. `away` has a list, a choice with Other, a toggle and `preview = true`. Each of the others labels its one field.
